# Deven Co-Work

> Deven Co-Work is a premium coworking space in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, built for founders, freelancers, remote workers and growing teams. It combines desks and private cabins with a podcast and content studio, a founder community and regular events.

Address: VIP Estate, A1, VIP Colony, Shankar Nagar, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492001, India. Phone: +91 62605 82852. Opening hours, plans and founding-member details are published on the website. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 9 PM.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.devencowork.com/): Overview of Deven Co-Work and how to book a free tour
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.devencowork.com/#pricing): Seat and cabin plans with current prices
- [The space](https://www.devencowork.com/#space): Desks, cabins, podcast and content studio
- [FAQ](https://www.devencowork.com/#faq): Answers about plans, trials and access
- [Book a free tour](https://www.devencowork.com/#reservation): Tour booking form and contact details
- [Private Office Cabins](https://www.devencowork.com/private-cabins): Three private office cabins for founders with 500 Mbps Wi-Fi and power backup
- [Meeting Room](https://www.devencowork.com/meeting-room): Team meeting room for 10–15 people with an interactive panel (digital board)
- [Content & Podcast Studio](https://www.devencowork.com/podcast-studio): In-house studio offering member podcast episodes, photoshoots and social collaborations
- [Free Trial](https://www.devencowork.com/free-trial): Free 2-day coworking trial with no credit card required
- [Pricing](https://www.devencowork.com/pricing): Membership plans and current pricing for desks and private cabins
- [Amenities](https://www.devencowork.com/amenities): Comprehensive directory of workspace facilities, high-speed Wi-Fi and community events

## What is on offer

- Hot desks, dedicated desks and private cabins
- Podcast and content studio
- Meeting room with an interactive digital panel
- 500 Mbps Wi-Fi, power backup and dedicated parking
- Coffee bar, book library and recreation space
- Workshops and community events for members
